text: The paper reports that the Outcome & Process Reward Model (OPRM), which combines process-level and final-answer supervision, outperforms ORMs and PRMs in re-ranking on PRM800K. Follow-up experiments on MetaMath/Math-Shepherd show no significant improvement from adding ORM training examples, which the authors attribute to Math-Shepherd process labels already being generated from final-answer rewards.
title: Outcome-and-process reward model (OPRM) beats ORM and PRM as easy-to-hard evaluator
